name: lp5
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;const o=[];for(const y of [1.9,2.0,2.2]){for(const z of [4.0,9.4]){const rc=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(-80,y,z),new T.Vector3(0,1,0));const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true).filter(v=>v.object.name.startsWith('main'));o.push('x-80 y'+y+' z'+z+' UP: '+(h[0]?h[0].object.name.replace('main:','')+'@y'+h[0].point.y.toFixed(3):'sky'));}}const rc=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(-80,1.9,9.4),new T.Vector3(0,1,0));const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true).filter(v=>v.object.name.startsWith('main'));const p=h[0]?h[0].point:null;o.push('normal: '+(h[0]?JSON.stringify({n:h[0].face&&h[0].face.normal,x:p.x.toFixed(2),y:p.y.toFixed(2),z:p.z.toFixed(2)}):'-'));return JSON.stringify(o)})()
